evidence.description: Confirmed all 18 REQ-001..018 each map to exactly one design-spec/plan-derived requirement, and every §8 money-safety invariant (key isolation, bridge-onramp-only funding, on-chain-verified ledger, no dry run) has a corresponding REQ (003, 006, 005, 018 respectively) -- structural mapping is otherwise complete.

Ground-truth wallet.mjs/api-server.mjs code shows REQ-003's 'single-process-invocation convention, not a cross-instance leak path' claim about the VINEYARD_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY override is factually incorrect for the persistent multi-instance api/server.mjs topology REQ-015 mandates (FIND-001).

Confirmed every REQ-001..018 has exactly one corresponding PROP-001..018 with a stated Tier and required flag, and the 10 required:true obligations are money-safety-relevant (PROP-003,004,005,006,010,012,013,014,017,018) -- the REQ<->PROP structural mapping is complete.

PROP-003's fast-check fuzzing plan for the single most important, required:true proof obligation does not cover the env-override-plus-multi-instance-per-process scenario that is the actual reachable leak path in the ground-truth code (FIND-002).

Purity Boundary Map's claims for core/ledger.mjs's realizedPnl and engines/lib/cost-basis.mjs's adjust do not match how those functions are actually implemented in the ground-truth plan (I/O is inline, not wrapped around a separable pure kernel) -- imprecise for the exact accounting logic REQ-005/REQ-008 depend on (FIND-003).
